observation.command:
echo "=== bitnami minio shell ==="; docker run --rm --entrypoint /bin/sh bitnamilegacy/minio:latest -c 'command -v curl; command -v bash; command -v mc; command -v /opt/bitnami/minio-client/bin/mc; echo ok' 2>&1 | head
echo "=== chainguard minio run test ==="; docker run -d --rm --name test-minio -e MINIO_ROOT_USER=testuser -e MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=testpass123 chainguard/minio:latest server /data --console-address ":9001" 2>&1; sleep 6; docker logs test-minio 2>&1 | tail -5; docker exec test-minio /usr/bin/mc --version 2>&1 | head -1; docker stop test-minio >/dev/null 2>&1
